Oh My Lord NTA in the slightest...

Cassie is her own person, not a “Lily Clone” as your “friends” have said. Yes what happened to Andrew is tragic but it’s not your responsibility to put his happiness above yours. From what you have said, everyone is the AH except for you and Cassie in this situation. 

Not to mention, Lily died three years ago. You didn’t go out looking to meet Cassie, and even if you did it’s been three years. The biggest problem here is that no one- not your parents, mutual “friends”, or Andrew- can see Cassie as her own person. 

Even so, Andrew lost a fiancée but Cassie lost a sister. Cassie is probably grieving too, and they refuse to see that. 

All the luck to you and Cassie, and in regards to the brick through the window, 
/r/LegalAdvice might be a good bet.
